en.headline: Customs seizes 7.3kg of suspected cannabis buds at airport, man charged
en.dek: A 23-year-old mainland man arriving from Bangkok was arrested after officers found the drugs in his carry-on baggage; he is due in West Kowloon Magistrates' Court today.
body: Hong Kong Customs said officers seized about 7.3 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds with an estimated market value of HK$1.6 million from the carry-on baggage of a passenger at Hong Kong International Airport on Thursday.

The 23-year-old mainland man had arrived from Bangkok, Thailand. He was arrested and has been charged with one count of trafficking in a dangerous drug. The case is scheduled to be mentioned at West Kowloon Magistrates' Court today.

Customs said it will continue to use intelligence analysis and risk assessment to select passengers from high-risk regions for checks. Under the Dangerous Drugs Ordinance, trafficking carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment.
The department reminded the public not to accept jobs or carry unknown items for others, as they could face serious criminal liability.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢獲7.3公斤懷疑大麻花 內地男被控販毒今日提堂
zh.dek: 23歲內地男子從曼谷抵港，海關在其隨身行李發現毒品，估計市值160萬元，案件今日於西九龍裁判法院提堂。
body: 香港海關表示，周四在香港國際機場檢獲約7.3公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約160萬港元，來自一名入境旅客的隨身行李。
該23歲內地男子從泰國曼谷抵港，隨即被捕，並被控一項販運危險藥物罪，案件今日於西九龍裁判法院提堂。
海關指會繼續根據情報分析及風險管理，重點檢查來自高風險地區的旅客。根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物最高可被判罰款500萬元及終身監禁。
海關呼籲市民切勿貪圖金錢而參與販毒，或為他人攜帶不明物品，以免觸犯嚴重罪行。
